title: Ethiopian Fondue
description: A unique appetizer or side dish that combines traditional Ethiopian flavors with a gooey, cheesy fondue.

ingredients.name: Gooey cheese
ingredients.notes: A blend of mozzarella and feta cheese

instructions: In a large saucepan, melt the butter over medium heat.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the flour and cook for 1-2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Slowly add the beer and stir until the mixture thickens.
Stir in the Ethiopian dish spice mix, paprika, and gooey cheese.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook for 2-3 minutes, stirring constantly.
Add the earthly mushrooms and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Transfer the fondue to a serving dish or fondue pot.
Serve immediately with bread or crackers for dipping.
Note: Traditionally, Ethiopian fondue is served with injera bread.
